install.step1.title: Download the latest release
install.step1.body: Grab the extension .zip from the GitHub Releases page and unzip it somewhere permanent (the folder must stay on disk while the extension is loaded).
install.step2.title: Open the extensions page
install.step2.body: Navigate to chrome://extensions in Chrome, Brave, or any Chromium browser.
install.step3.title: Enable Developer mode
install.step3.body: Toggle "Developer mode" in the top-right corner of the extensions page.
install.step4.title: Load unpacked
install.step4.body: Click "Load unpacked" and select the unzipped chrome-mv3 folder. Remote Inject now appears in your toolbar.
install.head.title: Install Remote Inject
install.head.description: Install the Remote Inject browser extension and pair your mobile wallet with any desktop dApp.
install.page.title: Install Remote Inject
install.page.lead: Remote Inject is a Chromium (MV3) extension. A Chrome Web Store listing is on the way; until then, load it unpacked from a GitHub release.
install.section.load.title: Load the extension
install.section.pair.title: Pair your wallet
install.pair.step1.title: Open any dApp
install.pair.step1.body: Visit a dApp and click its connect button. Choose Remote Inject from the wallet list (or it becomes window.ethereum automatically when no other wallet is installed).
install.pair.step2.title: Scan the QR code
install.pair.step2.body: The side panel shows a QR code and a four-digit pairing code. Scan it with any mobile wallet that has a built-in dApp browser (MetaMask, OKX, Trust…) — it opens the Remote Inject bridge page inside the wallet.
install.pair.step3.title: Confirm the four digits
install.pair.step3.body: Verify the four-digit code on your phone matches the extension, then approve. You are connected — signing happens on your phone from now on.
install.section.settings.title: Settings
install.settings.body: By default Remote Inject uses the public relay at wss://relay.walletpair.org/v1. You can point it at any WalletPair relay from the extension's Settings panel — self-host the relay if you prefer full control. Changing the relay simply requires re-pairing.
